name: patch-by-query-older-than-sweeps-old-rows
$comment: Execution-time-relative olderThan in a patchByQuery filter: rows whose epoch-ms field is strictly older than now − ms match, evaluated with the execution clock (wall-clock on the server, the injected ~1.7e12 clock in engines — the margins make the exact value irrelevant: completedAt 1 is below any cutoff for decades, 9e15 above it forever). This is the primitive a scheduled sweep uses: the stored txn carries no cutoff literal, so every fire re-derives it.
